LanguageData.Lumen_Warp_BatteryRule: Every Bloodstone battery on a map shares one Warp network. Stored energy is lost if the battery is destroyed or deconstructed. It cannot be moved, and loses no charge over time.
LanguageData.Lumen_Warp_AltarReachDesc: A Harvest Warp Energy sacrifice fills only batteries within this distance of the altar.
LanguageData.Lumen_Warp_Depleted: Depleted. Active effects resume at {0} stored.
LanguageData.Lumen_Warp_Hysteresis: Stored Warp energy needed to recover from depletion
